description: This file contains legacy helper functions for tenant selection management, including getting and setting the active tenant ID in local storage and determining if tenant selection UI is needed.

methods.name: getActiveTenantId
methods.description: Reads the active tenant ID from local storage, using the preferred key 'activeTenant', fallback to legacy 'activeTenantId'.

methods.name: setActiveTenantId
methods.description: Sets the active tenant ID in local storage with the key 'activeTenant', and removes legacy key 'activeTenantId'.

methods.name: needsTenantSelection
methods.description: Determines whether tenant selection UI is needed based on whether an active tenant is set and the number of tenants available.
